33. If roots of the equation $x^{2}-10 c x-11 d=0$ are a, b and those of $x^{2}-10 a x-11 b=0$ are c, d, then the value of $\mathrm{a}+\mathrm{b}+\mathrm{c}+\mathrm{d}$ is (a, b, c and d are distinct numbers)

Sol. $\quad \operatorname{As} \mathrm{a}+\mathrm{b}=10 \mathrm{c}$ and $\mathrm{c}+\mathrm{d}=10 \mathrm{a}$
$$\begin{aligned}
& a b=-11 d, c d=-11 b \\
\Rightarrow & a c=121 \text { and }(b+d)=9(a+c) \\
& a^{2}-10 a c-11 d=0 \\
& c^{2}-10 a c-11 b=0 \\
\Rightarrow & a^{2}+c^{2}-20 a c-11(b+d)=0 \\
\Rightarrow & (a+c)^{2}-22(121)-11 \times 9(a+c)=0 \\
\Rightarrow & (a+c)=121 \text { or }-22 \text { (rejected) } \\
\therefore & a+b+c+d=1210 .
\end{aligned}$$
